notes: Grade as I scan: Card Grader watches the folder your scanner saves to and grades each card a few seconds after you scan it.
Recognizes the card from the scan: it reads the name and number and finds the exact card, so you don't have to type it.
Deal check: the most you should pay for a card, from a scan or just the seller's photos.
eBay sold-listing links in folder results and History.
